record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.summary: PassiveEffects[Passive.EMERGENCY_EXIT] holds one shared OnSpawnEffect that calls pkm.addPP(pkm.maxPP, pkm, 0, false) when the entity is spawned (after synergy and item effects). The requested gain is maxPP (100 for both units); apBoost 0 and crit false mean no AP or crit scaling. addPP rounds the request (halved first under fatigue, since the request is positive), drops it when the unit is silenced, has status.protect (not Rune Protect), has the NO_PP_GAIN effect or is resurrecting, and otherwise stores pp = clamp(pp + value, 0, 2*maxPP - 1). A fresh entity starts at pp 0, so with no blocking state the final pp is 100 = maxPP; the next time the attack cooldown ends a unit with pp >= maxPP and canCast casts FIRST_IMPRESSION instead of basic-attacking, and the cast spends maxPP (pp floored at 0). Nothing else is done by the passive.
triggers: OnSpawnEffect applied in Simulation.addPokemon when the entity is created (fight start or later spawn)
OnSpawnEffect applied to the rebuilt clone in PokemonEntity.resurrect (see unresolved)

effects.declaredRaw: requested PP gain = the unit's maxPP (100), caster = holder, apBoost 0, crit false
effects.scaling: none: no AP, crit or star scaling. Fatigue would halve a positive request (round(100 x 0.5) = 50); Twist Band only flips negative values, so a positive gain is unchanged (core-mechanics section J3); Big Eater Belt is not applied by addPP.
effects.resolution: requested 100; applied value 100 (50 under fatigue; 0 when silenced, status.protect, NO_PP_GAIN or resurrecting). Final stored pp = clamp(0 + applied, 0, 199) = 100 for a fresh entity with no blocking state, which equals maxPP; Rune Protect alone blocks nothing. The statuses and effects present at the moment the OnSpawnEffect runs (items and synergies are applied first) decide whether a block applies; which of them can be present at spawn was not enumerated.

effects.declaredRaw: no declared amount; consequence of pp = maxPP
effects.resolution: the check pp >= maxPP && canCast is made when the attack cooldown ends; a silenced unit, a Nullify Bandana holder or a pending Teleport cannot cast even with full PP, so the PP stays full until canCast is true. A cast subtracts maxPP, leaving pp 0 for these units afterward unless other gains arrived (attack +5 and damage-based gains, core-mechanics section B).

conditions: no weather, star or team condition; applies to every entity of WIMPOD and GOLISOPOD
evaluated once per spawn; pp at that moment is normally 0, so the result is the cap-free value maxPP
record.resetBehaviour: No counter or per-entity state in the effect. After PokemonEntity.resurrect the real entity's pp is set to 0 (line 1564); the OnSpawn effect runs on the rebuilt clone, not on the real entity, in the cited lines.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Which statuses or effects can already be present on a fresh entity when this OnSpawnEffect runs (for example NO_PP_GAIN or fatigue from items or synergies) was not enumerated
Timing of the first attack decision (movement, targeting, cooldown reset) was not traced, so how soon the first FIRST_IMPRESSION cast happens is unknown
FIRST_IMPRESSION behaviour is covered by its own record, not here
unresolved: Routing uncertainties: none recorded in the queue; a name search of app (excluding built client files) found only the PassiveEffects entry, the two unit classes and the enum
Whether OnSpawn effects can run a second time on the same real entity (dish consumption, later spawn) and so add PP again was not traced
The name 'EMERGENCY_EXIT' suggests a retreat mechanic, but the traced code only fills PP; no movement or exit logic was found in this passive
No gameplay evidence; candidate is source reading plus mechanical checks only
